meta.note: Sunlit gold (24 October 2026; the owner asked for light mode, a premium oil feel and vastu): warm white and ivory grounds, warm-black type and one metallic gold for everything that acts. No black or dark-grey fields. The drop tints are the products' own illustrated colours. The same palette prints.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page: warm white. text 18.3:1, text-2 9.8:1, text-3 6.0:1, gold-ink 6.2:1 on it.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Ivory: alternate bands, the footer, the product stage. text 16.5:1, text-3 5.5:1, gold-ink 5.6:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, spec tables, forms, menus and secondary buttons. text 18.6:1, text-3 6.1:1 on it.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: A surface under a pointer or pressed. text-3 5.1:1 on it.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating chrome only (product local nav, phone action bar, tray), over a 24px backdrop blur. Opaque ground under reduced transparency or increased contrast. Never on content.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Warm black, never pure black: headings and primary text (18.3:1 on ground).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Body copy (9.8:1 on ground, 8.9:1 on ivory).

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, labels and placeholders (6.0:1 on ground, 5.1:1 at worst).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The one action colour as a fill: primary buttons, selected chips, the closing band. text on it 7.8:1. Never text on the page: use gold-ink.

tokens.name: gold-pressed
tokens.usage: A gold fill under a pointer or pressed (text on it 6.6:1).

tokens.name: gold-sheen
tokens.usage: The highlight of a gold band's sheen. Decorative.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold-family text: links, eyebrows, grade codes; and the focus ring. 6.2:1 on ground, 5.3:1 at worst.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: The 1px edge of a gold fill, rules, the marker on the colour scale (4.8:1 on ground).

tokens.name: gold-tint
tokens.usage: A quiet gold surface: tags, selected rows, text selection. text 15.8:1, gold-ink 5.4:1 on it.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold (7.8:1).

tokens.name: on-gold-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on gold (5.5:1 on gold, 6.8:1 on its sheen).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that identify a control: inputs, secondary buttons, chips (3.8:1 on ground, 3.2:1 at worst). Also unlit statement words (3.4:1 on ivory, large text).

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The brand's own green: live, active or done (6.5:1 on ground).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, always with an icon and words (6.4:1 on ground).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner, with danger text (5.7:1).

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a notice.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on warning-tint (6.9:1).
